svg.title: Everything Toll does
svg.desc: Check, before it buys: coin check, LARP check, dev record, hook check, wallet privacy. Sign, before it signs: pre-sign check, ERC-8481 report, protect RPC, ALLOW tickets, approvals and revoke. Pay, before it pays: x402 facilitator, payee check ERC-8478, escrow, batch and upto, signed receipts, x402 market. Build: launch an agent, 11 templates, MCP with 28 tools, SDKs and plugins, stock token data. Watch, after the trade: Telegram alerts, webhooks, launch record, open blocklist, chain pulse.
svg.text: 25 parts, all live on Robinhood Chain
